splitPolicy: Six preselected development domains; six different holdout institutions independently annotated without reading parser outputs. Prior six exploratory domains excluded. CMS/template independence is not guaranteed.
revealPolicy: Stage 1 froze parser 1fbffb5c before reading the original holdout and preserved its 4/6 result. Two discovered defects were then fixed; the original holdout became regression data. A new independent four-institution confirmation set is evaluated only after final parser 28991ac4 is frozen; no tuning after confirmation.
annotationPolicy: Expected title, absolute URL and visible publication date come from official page DOM, not parser predictions. Raw bytes retained as gzip with SHA256. Site-specific annotation selectors are benchmark data only.
matching: Exact absolute URL with fragment removed AND title normalized for whitespace and one leading decorative bullet. Query parameters and title content retained.
reportSeparately: target not present on input page
datePolicy: Dates measured separately from title/link precision; null ground truth excluded from date denominator. Missing predicted dates on known ground truth are incorrect.
limitations: Small purposive sample within SJTU; not a random sample or school-wide success-rate estimate. Independent DOM labels are not double-blind expert adjudication. Both all-input and labeled-page denominators must be shown.
